batch: Four complete Brill corpus editions supplied by the researcher while consulting Library of Congress holdings
policy: The PDFs are retained only in the private content-addressed archive. This evidence record and the public-facing corpus store bibliographic facts, catalogue structure, object identifiers, source locators, and conservative source-attributed classifications; they do not reproduce the copyrighted transcriptions, translations, commentary, or photographs and do not authorize public reuse.

documents.bibliographic_findings: James Nathan Ford and Matthew Morgenstern, Aramaic Incantation Bowls in Museum Collections, Volume One: The Frau Professor Hilprecht Collection of Babylonian Antiquities, Jena, Magical and Religious Literature of Late Antiquity 8 (Leiden/Boston: Brill, 2020); hardback ISBN 978-90-04-37700-4; e-book ISBN 978-90-04-41183-8; copyright 2020 Koninklijke Brill NV.
documents.scope_findings: Complete collection catalogue. Entries 1-40 edit legible Aramaic texts (JBA/Hebrew, Syriac, and Mandaic); entries 41-68 catalogue pseudoscript, uninscribed, non-Aramaic, fragmentary, or non-bowl material. Entry 69 is a single storage-box record for multiple fragments from different objects and is documented in the evidence but deliberately not converted into one physical-object record.

enumeration_policy.identity_linking: An appearance is attached to an existing object only when either an exact whitespace-normalized collection designation or an exact publication-object key resolves to one object. Ambiguous or absent matches create a separate candidate; no dedupe decision or merge is made.
enumeration_policy.copyright_boundary: No transcription, translation, commentary passage, or embedded image from these volumes is inserted into the database or public export.
